backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing user authentication, access control (admin/user/guest roles), user profiles, trending movies/TV shows management, tracked shows per user, and blob storage integration.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting five high-confidence features related to restoring TrailerModal functionality, implementing trailer fetching, updating MediaCard integration, handling UI states, and configuring z-index for modal visibility.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-existing summaries of frontend files including App.tsx, hooks, components (Header, Hero, MediaCard, TrailerModal, etc.), configuration files, and documentation.
frontend/.env.example: Environment variable template defining VITE_APP_VERSION=42 for deterministic build versioning.
frontend/.gitignore: Git ignore configuration excluding node_modules, build artifacts, logs, editor files, and environment variable files from version control.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script loading main.tsx for the Movie & TV Show Trending App.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component orchestrating authentication flow, profile setup dialog, theme provider, query client defaults, and layout with Header, Hero, NetflixTop10, FeaturedRow, Footer, and ApiHealthBanner.
frontend/src/components/AddShowDialog.ts: Empty file placeholder for glassmorphic modal dialog to search and add TV shows to tracked list.
Conditional banner component displaying yellow alert when TMDB API queries fail for movies or TV shows.
frontend/src/components/ContentGrid.tsx: Empty file placeholder for memoized content grid with glassmorphic design and CSS containment optimization.
frontend/src/components/FeaturedRow.tsx: Memoized section displaying up to 12 trending movies in a responsive grid with loading skeletons and error handling.
frontend/src/components/FilterBar.tsx: Empty file placeholder for filter and sort controls with dropdowns for media type, genre, and sort options.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with copyright notice, caffeine.ai attribution with UTM tracking, and TMDB credit link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header with app title, film icon, and login/logout button integrated with Internet Identity authentication and query cache clearing.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero section with theater background image, gradient overlay, and animated heading for trending content discovery.
frontend/src/components/MediaCard.tsx: A memoized React component that displays a media item (movie/TV show) card with poster image, title, rating, and a hover overlay with a "Watch Trailer" button that opens a TrailerModal.
frontend/src/components/NetflixTop10.tsx: Displays the top 10 trending TV shows in a grid layout with numbered badges, using the useGetTrendingTVShows hook and rendering MediaCard components with loading and error states.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupDial: A modal dialog that prompts new users to enter their name to create a profile, using the useSaveCallerUserProfile mutation and preventing dismissal until completed.
frontend/src/components/TrailerModal.tsx: A dialog component that fetches and displays YouTube trailers for movies/TV shows using the useGetTrailer hook, with loading, error, and no-trailer states.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, creating authenticated or anonymous actors and invalidating dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context and hooks for login/logout functionality, managing AuthClient creation, identity persistence, and authentication status throughout the React component tree.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for user profile management (get/save) and TMDB API data fetching (trending movies, TV shows, and trailers) with fallback logic and error handling.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark theme colors using OKLCH color space, plus a fade-in animation utility.
frontend/src/lib/mediaKeys.ts: Utility functions to generate unique keys for MediaItem objects and deduplicate arrays of media items based on media_type and id.
frontend/src/lib/versionGuard.ts: Validates that the runtime VITE_APP_VERSION matches an expected hardcoded version ('42') and logs a warning on mismatch in production builds to detect deployment issues.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React application entry point that renders the App component wrapped in QueryClientProvider (TanStack React Query) and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication.
frontend/src/vite-env.d.ts: TypeScript ambient declarations extending Vite's ImportMetaEnv interface to include the optional VITE_APP_VERSION string.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color tokens (using oklch CSS variables), container settings, border radii, animations (accordion), and plugins (typography, container-queries, animate).
project_state.json: Project metadata and architectural documentation describing CineStream as a React+Motoko IC dApp for TMDB movie/TV discovery with Internet Identity auth, TanStack Query data layer, access-controlled backend storage, and a planned stabilization/bugfix audit.
